tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Free. Short usage index. Then search_components to pick ids.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Free. Compact catalog TSV: id, provides, requires, conflictsWith. Omit args for all.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: One component's source files, UNRENDERED (EJS markers, not build-ready): inspect only; use purchase_scaffold for real files. Free, 32/day, signed-in account.

tools.name: purchase_scaffold
tools.description: Buys a CI-green starter repo for component ids (credits via your signed-in account, or x402). Returns a git clone command and projectid. Red builds are refused and not charged. delivery "inline" returns files instead (more tokens).

tools.name: get_scaffold
tools.description: Refetches a scaffold you purchased (fresh clone command), no extra credits. Credit-flow projects need Maintain on. Same site_profile/delivery options as purchase_scaffold.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Lists this account's saved scaffold projects (id, name, description, repo, components, maintain state). Use the projectid with get_scaffold to re-fetch a scaffold — no project_api_key is needed as a tool argument.

tools.name: set_projects
tools.description: Turn Maintain on/off for a project and/or rotate its project key. Off keeps existing clones; it stops future get_scaffold access.

tools.name: get_siteprofile
tools.description: Your site profiles (privacy, terms, cookies, licence, custom_field) as JSON. list: true for names, or siteprofilename for one; field filters. Use next.arguments when a purchase reply says incomplete: true.

tools.name: set_siteprofile
tools.description: Creates or updates one named site profile for this account. Fields omitted from `field` keep their current saved value (or blank, if the profile is new); pass only what changed. custom_field entries are merged key-by-key. An account may keep more than one named profile (e.g. one per brand/site).

tools.name: get_adminpageset
tools.description: Lists this account's admin page set names (omit name), or returns one set's exact files (pass name). These are the file trees purchase_scaffold's admin_page_set param bakes into a dedicated forked repo. Requires a linked account (transport auth).

tools.name: set_adminpageset
tools.description: Creates or fully replaces one named admin page set for this account — real file source (React/Next.js), not text config. purchase_scaffold's admin_page_set param bakes a chosen set into a brand-new, dedicated repo. An account may keep more than one named set.

tools.name: verify_scaffold
tools.description: Remote `npm install && npm run build` of your edited files (send every file). Call with files -> WAIT + jobId; call again with jobId -> OK or FAIL with the error tail. Needs a purchased projectid.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report a catalog/code bug or request a component (files an issue on botkelp/components). Signed-in account, 10/day. No secrets.

tools.name: get_github
tools.description: Shows whether this account has a GitHub repo connected, or lists files under a path in that repo. If not connected, the result includes installUrl — open it (GitHub App) to grant read access to one repo. Sign in on botkelp.com with GitHub first so the install is tied to your account.

tools.name: set_github
tools.description: Returns a GitHub App install URL so the user can grant BotKelp read access to one of their repos. Open the URL, pick a single repo, approve. Then purchase_scaffold template_files: [{ source: "app/legal/" }] copies those pages into the clone. disconnect: true drops the connection. Prefer signing in w

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: No params. Says whether you are signed in (authenticated) and account tools work (accountToolsReady). Never returns a key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: set_github · Private data: get_component, purchase_scaffold, get_adminpageset, set_adminpageset, verify_scaffold, report_issue, get_github · Public sink: verify_scaffold · Destructive: verify_scaffold.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: set_github · Private data: get_component, purchase_scaffold, get_adminpageset, set_adminpageset, verify_scaffold, report_issue, get_github · Public sink: verify_scaffold · Destructive: verify_scaffold

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
